gloss: to crawl up, to clamber up

definitions.gloss: to crawl up, to clamber up
definitions.explanation: To climb upward by crawling; to ascend with difficulty using hands and body.

definitions.gloss: to rise from a difficult situation
definitions.explanation: (Figurative) To struggle up from hardship or a low position; to work one's way up.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{階段|かいだん}を{這|は}い{上|あ}がろうとしている。
examples.english: The baby is trying to crawl up the stairs.

examples.japanese: {崖|がけ}を{必死|ひっし}に{這|は}い{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I desperately clambered up the cliff.

examples.japanese: {どん底|どんぞこ}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がってきた{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He's someone who rose from rock bottom.

examples.japanese: {虫|むし}が{壁|かべ}を{這|は}い{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: An insect is crawling up the wall.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {這|は}う + {上|あ}がる.

COMPOUND VERB PATTERN: ～{上|あ}がる compounds indicate upward movement:
・{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる (to run up)
・{浮|う}き{上|あ}がる (to float up)
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる (to jump up)
・{這|は}い{出|で}る (to crawl out - related)

FIGURATIVE USE: Common in rags-to-riches stories and descriptions of overcoming adversity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{地獄|じごく}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がる (rise from hell)
・{どん底|どんぞこ}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がる (rise from rock bottom)
